units.source_text: 即使所謂的「死相」，也應該比這張照片更有表情、更讓人印象深刻吧，

en.t: Even a so-called death mask ought to have more expression and leave a stronger impression than this photograph,

units.source_text: 也就是把馬頭安裝在人身上的這種感覺吧。

en.t: It is like the feeling of a horse's head being fastened onto a human body.

units.source_text: 總之，這張照片會讓看到的人莫名地毛骨悚然，心情變壞。

en.t: In any case, this photograph somehow makes anyone who sees it shudder and feel unpleasant.

units.source_text: 迄今為止，我從未見過長相如此怪異的男人。

en.t: Until now, I had never seen a man with such a strange face.
